githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.5 introduces completely redesigned Settings, native sticker and soundboard pickers, pinned messages, and new appearance styles and shareable themes. It also adds profile customization and widgets, Discord account import, and improvements to messaging, calls, and performance.

## Redesigned Settings

- Rebuilt Settings with searchable pages and controls, covering startup, messaging, notifications, voice and video, accessibility, privacy, storage, diagnostics, and updates.
- Added customizable keyboard shortcuts, configurable message send keys, cosmetic visibility controls, and more detailed notification and call preferences.
- Added settings import and export with selectable categories, alongside account details and logged-in device information.
- Added trusted-domain management, storage limits, download preferences, and shareable diagnostic reports.

## Appearance and themes

- Added System, Light, and Dark appearances and a Theme Designer with up to five gradient colors, saturation, brightness, and window opacity controls.
- Added shareable theme links with in-chat previews and an Apply Theme action.
- Added optional iMessage-style message bubbles, adjustable spacing and timestamps, and an interactive conversation preview.
- Redesigned the composer with selectable input-bar styles and reorderable GIF, sticker, and emoji buttons.

## Stickers, soundboard, and pinned messages

- Added a searchable sticker picker with favorites, frequently used stickers, server collections, Discord packs, and animated previews.
- Added a soundboard picker with search, favorites, local previews, downloads, and playback in supported voice channels.
- Added pinned-message browsing in server chats and DMs, with pin and unpin actions and direct navigation to the original message.
- Refreshed emoji and GIF pickers with context-menu actions, improved keyboard navigation, and Discord-synced emoji favorites.

## Profiles and sign-in

- Added native editing for main and per-server profiles, including avatars, banners, bios, colors, display-name styles, and available cosmetics.
- Added expanded profiles with editable personal and game widgets.
- Redesigned the sidebar account and voice controls, with quick access to profiles, presence, account switching, and call actions.
- Added account import from Discord desktop, refreshed sign-in and MFA screens, and introduced theme customization during first-launch setup.

## Messaging and reliability

- Improved attachment sending, added clearer retry and discard actions for failed messages, and introduced slowmode countdowns.
- Added composer Undo and consistent Markdown formatting, with more responsive typing.
- Improved voice reconnection, draft isolation, message confirmation, relevant-channel visibility, and Regular/Nightly update switching.
- Reduced animation memory use and fixed fullscreen scrolling, light-mode contrast, and popover navigation.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.4...v0.1.5](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.4...v0.1.5)
discordAnnouncement:
**Redesigned Settings, custom themes, stickers, and soundboard 🌸**

**Highlights**
- Completely redesigned, searchable Settings with new controls for notifications, calls, privacy, accessibility, shortcuts, and settings import/export
- Shareable gradient themes, adjustable window opacity, iMessage-style bubbles, and customizable composer styles
- Native sticker and soundboard pickers with search, favorites, and previews
- Browse pinned messages, pin or unpin, and jump straight to the original conversation
- Edit main and per-server profiles, customize cosmetics and widgets, and import accounts from Discord desktop
- Improved message delivery, slowmode feedback, voice recovery, typing responsiveness, and memory use
